initialExam.title: MPTET 2026 (Madhya Pradesh TET)
initialExam.description: MP Teacher Eligibility Test for primary and middle school teacher recruitment in Madhya Pradesh government schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Primary: Child Dev, Hindi, English, Math, EVS. Middle: Child Dev, Hindi, English, Subject.
initialExam.examPattern: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours per paper. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: MPTET Qualification → MP Varg 3 Teacher Recruitment
initialExam.careerGrowth: Varg 3 → Varg 2 → Varg 1 → Head Master → BEO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit peb.mp.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
